_comment: Multi-account sync targets for the goobs-frontend Claude Design project. The operator keeps the SAME design system synced from two different claude.ai accounts. config.json's `projectId` must always be the project on the CURRENTLY logged-in account (the converter only allows a single projectId, and a foreign-account id 404s). RESOLVE PROCEDURE at each sync start: for each id below, DesignSync(get_project); the one(s) that return successfully are on the active account → set config.json projectId to that id and sync to it. Each account's project is updated whenever that account is the one logged in; switch accounts + re-sync to update the other.

targets.label: account-B
targets.note: the original project on the other account; update it by switching to that account and re-syncing
